name: web-push-demo
description: Web Push 注册订阅 + 定向推送演示服务

scripts.cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certs/server.key -out certs/server.crt -days 3650 -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1' && echo 'certs/server.crt + certs/server.key 已生成'
